<title>Yellow Falcon 57</title>
<style>
/* Yellow Falcon 57 by faxriddin20 — https://uiverse.io/faxriddin20/yellow-falcon-57 */
.download-btn {
  border: 2px solid rgb(168, 38, 255);
  background-color: white;
  width: 50px;
  height: 50px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.download-btn svg {
  width: 25px;
  height: 25px;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}
.download-btn:hover svg {
  fill: white;
}
.download-btn:hover {
  background-color: rgb(168, 38, 255);
}
</style>
